terminal.name: Hernesaari Cruise Terminal
terminal.notes: Main large-ship cruise area southwest of central Helsinki.

terminals.name: Hernesaari Cruise Terminal
terminals.notes: Main large-ship cruise area southwest of central Helsinki.

terminals.name: Katajanokka Cruise Quay
terminals.notes: Central cruise quay on Katajanokka, separate from the regular ferry terminal.

terminals.name: West Harbour Cruise Quay
terminals.notes: Cruise berth in Helsinki's West Harbour passenger-port complex.

pois.name: Vesikko
pois.intro: Vesikko is a submarine, which was launched on 10 May 1933 at the Crichton-Vulcan dock in Turku. Until 1936 it was named by its yard number CV 707.

pois.name: Didrichsenin taidemuseo
pois.intro: Didrichsen Art Museum is an art museum in Helsinki, Finland.

pois.name: Sinebrychoffin taidemuseo
pois.intro: The Sinebrychoff Art Museum is an art museum located on Bulevardi in Helsinki, Finland. The museum exhibits the old European art collections of the Finnish National Gallery.

pois.name: Löyly
pois.intro: Löyly is a public sauna, restaurant and bar in Hernesaari, Helsinki, Finland. Its address is Hernesaarenranta 4.

pois.name: Cafe Regatta
pois.intro: Cafe Regatta is a café in Taka-Töölö, Helsinki, Finland. The café building is a small red log cabin that has been located in the same place on the Merikannontie street, on the shores of the Taivallahti bay, since 1887.

pois.name: Cafe Ekberg
pois.intro: Ekberg is a café, pâtisserie and bakery shop on Bulevardi in Kamppi, Helsinki, Finland. It was founded by Fredrik Edvard Ekberg in 1852, making it the oldest café still in operation in Finland.

pois.name: Suomenlinnan linnoitus
pois.intro: Suomenlinna, or Sveaborg, is a sea fortress composed of eight islands, of which six have been fortified. Located about four kilometres southeast of the city center of Helsinki, Finland, Suomenlinna is a popular destination for both tourists and locals, who enjoy it as a picturesque picnic site.

pois.name: Helsingin tuomiokirkko
pois.intro: Helsinki Cathedral is the Finnish Evangelical Lutheran cathedral of the Diocese of Helsinki, located in the neighborhood of Kruununhaka in the centre of Helsinki, Finland, at the Senate Square. The church was originally built from 1830 to 1852 as a tribute to the Grand Duke of Finland, Emperor Nicholas I of Russia.

pois.name: Ateneum
pois.intro: Ateneum is an art museum in Helsinki, Finland and one of the three museums forming the Finnish National Gallery. It is located in the centre of Helsinki on the south side of Rautatientori square close to Helsinki Central railway station.

pois.name: Kansallismuseo
pois.intro: The National Museum of Finland is a museum in Helsinki presenting Finnish history from the Stone Age to the present day, through objects and cultural history. The Finnish National Romantic style building is located at Mannerheimintie 34 in central Helsinki and is a part of the Finnish Heritage Agency, under the Ministry of Culture and Education.

pois.name: Havis Amanda
pois.intro: Havis Amanda is a fountain and a statue in Helsinki, Finland by the sculptor Ville Vallgren. The work was modelled in 1906 in Paris, and erected at its present location at the Market Square in Kaartinkaupunki in 1908.

pois.name: Temppeliaukion kirkko
pois.intro: Temppeliaukio Church is a Lutheran church in the Töölö neighbourhood of Helsinki, Finland. The church was designed by architects and brothers Timo and Tuomo Suomalainen and opened in 1969.

pois.name: Uspenskin katedraali
pois.intro: Uspenski Cathedral is a Greek Orthodox or Eastern Orthodox cathedral in Helsinki, Finland, and main cathedral of the Orthodox Church of Finland, dedicated to the Dormition of the Theotokos. Its name comes from the Old Church Slavonic word uspenie, which denotes the Dormition.

pois.name: Presidentinlinna
pois.intro: The Presidential Palace is one of the three official residences of the president of the Republic of Finland. It is situated in Helsinki, on the north side of Esplanadi, overlooking Market Square.

pois.name: Sibelius-monumentti
pois.intro: The Sibelius Monument is a public art memorial to the Finnish composer Jean Sibelius, who died in 1957. Situated in Sibelius Park within the Töölö district of Helsinki, the monument is by the Finnish sculptor Eila Hiltunen, whose design—Passio Musicae—won a contentious, and therefore protracted, competition that the Sibelius Society of Finland held from 1961 to 1962.

pois.name: Linnanmäki
pois.intro: Linnanmäki is an amusement park in Helsinki, Finland. It was opened on 27 May 1950 and is owned by the non-profit Children's Day Foundation, which operates the park to raise funds for Finnish child welfare work.

pois.name: Esplanadinpuisto
pois.intro: Esplanadi, colloquially known as Espa, is an esplanade and urban park in downtown Helsinki, Finland, situated between the Erottaja square and the Market Square. It is bordered on its northern and southern sides by the Pohjoisesplanadi and Eteläesplanadi streets, respectively.

pois.name: Eduskuntatalo
pois.intro: The Parliament House is the seat of the Parliament of Finland. It is located in the Finnish capital Helsinki, in the district of Etu-Töölö.

pois.name: Seurasaari
pois.intro: Seurasaari is an island and a district in Helsinki, Finland, known mostly as the location of the Seurasaari Open-Air Museum, which consists of old, mainly wooden buildings transplanted from elsewhere in Finland and placed in the dense forest landscape of the island. Every summer, many Helsinkians come to Seurasaari to enjoy the rural, peaceful outdoor atmosphere.

pois.name: Tamminiemi
pois.intro: Tamminiemi is a villa and house museum located in the Meilahti district of Helsinki, Finland. It was one of the three official residences of the President of Finland, from 1940 to 1982.

pois.name: Korkeasaaren eläintarha
pois.intro: Korkeasaari Zoo, also known as Helsinki Zoo, is the largest zoo in Finland, located in Helsinki's Korkeasaari island. The zoo was first opened in 1889.

pois.name: Tuomiokirkon krypta
pois.nameEnglish: The Crypt of the Helsinki Cathedral
pois.intro: Helsinki Cathedral is the Finnish Evangelical Lutheran cathedral of the Diocese of Helsinki, located in the neighborhood of Kruununhaka in the centre of Helsinki, Finland, at the Senate Square. The church was originally built from 1830 to 1852 as a tribute to the Grand Duke of Finland, Emperor Nicholas I of Russia.

pois.name: Helsingin kaupunginmuseo
pois.intro: Helsinki City Museum is a museum in Helsinki that documents and displays the history of Helsinki, the capital of Finland. Its mission is to record and uphold Helsinki's spiritual, material and architectural heritage.

pois.name: Luonnontieteellinen museo
pois.intro: The Natural History Museum is one of the museums under the directorship of the Finnish Museum of Natural History, part of the University of Helsinki, in Helsinki, Finland.

pois.name: Mannerheim-museo
pois.intro: The Mannerheim Museum is located in Helsinki, Finland. It is dedicated to preserving and displaying items related to the life and times of Marshal C. G. E. Mannerheim, a Finnish statesman and military officer.

pois.name: Valokuvataiteen museo
pois.intro: Le musée finlandais de la photographie est un musée à Helsinki.

pois.name: Helsingin taidemuseo HAM
pois.intro: Helsinki Art Museum, abbreviated as HAM, is an art museum in Helsinki, Finland. It is located in Tennispalatsi in the district of Kamppi.

pois.name: Amos Rex
pois.intro: Amos Rex is an independent, privately funded contemporary art museum named after the publisher and arts patron Amos Anderson and located in Lasipalatsi, on Mannerheimintie boulevard in Helsinki, Finland. It opened in 2018 and rapidly reached international popularity, attracting more than 10,000 visitors in a matter of weeks.

pois.name: Ratikkamuseo
pois.intro: Le musée du Tramway est un musée consacré au tramway, situé dans le quartier de Taka-Töölö à Helsinki en Finlande.

pois.name: Sea Horse
pois.intro: Sea Horse is a restaurant in Ullanlinna, Helsinki, Finland, founded in 1934. Since its founding, it has paid attention to the traditional Finnish restaurant culture with both its interior and its menu.

pois.name: Ravintola Savoy
pois.intro: Savoy is a restaurant in Helsinki, Finland, located on the Eteläesplanadi street. The restaurant opened on 3 June 1937.

pois.name: HSS Paviljonki
pois.intro: Helsingfors Segelsällskap r.f. is the second oldest yacht club in Helsinki, established in 1893.

pois.name: Inari
pois.intro: Inari on Helsingissä Albertinkadulla sijaitseva ravintola. Se avautui kesällä 2018, ja sitä pitää ravintoloitsija-kokki Kim Mikkola.

pois.name: Demo
pois.intro: Ravintola Demo on vuonna 2003 avattu helsinkiläinen fine dining -ravintola. Ravintola toimi pitkään Uudenmaankadulla Punavuoressa, kunnes se muutti lokakuussa 2024 Ruoholahteen We Land -tornitalon ylimpään kerrokseen.

pois.name: St Urho's Pub
pois.intro: St. Urho's Pub is a beer restaurant located at Museokatu 10 in Etu-Töölö, Helsinki, Finland.

pois.name: Vltava
pois.intro: Vltava is the largest Czech cuisine restaurant in Finland, located in central Helsinki. It was opened in the spring of 2005 to a Jugend architecture building protected by the Finnish National Board of Antiquities, located on the Elielinaukio square, between the Helsinki Central railway station and the main building of the Finnish post office.

pois.name: Vanha Kauppahalli
pois.intro: The Old Market Hall is the oldest market hall in Helsinki, Finland. It is located along the Eteläranta street near the Helsinki Market Square in the Kaartinkaupunki district.

pois.name: Hietalahden kauppahalli
pois.intro: The Hietalahti market hall is an old market hall located near the Hietalahdentori market square in Helsinki, Finland, hosting several restaurants and cafés. The market hall acts as concentration for restaurants and cafés, offering Japanese, Portuguese, Italian, French and Middle Eastern cuisine both at lunchtime and in the evening.

pois.name: Sokos
pois.intro: Sokos-huset är en byggnad mellan Mannerheimvägen, Postgatan, Stationsplatsen och Brunnsgatan i Helsingfors. Huset ritades av Erkki Huttunen och stod färdigt 1952.

pois.name: Forum
pois.intro: Forum is a shopping centre in Helsinki, Finland, opened in 1985 and located between the streets of Mannerheimintie, Simonkatu, Yrjönkatu and Kalevankatu. The original Forum building is located in the corner of Mannerheimintie and Simonkatu.

pois.name: Hakaniemen kauppahalli
pois.intro: The Hakaniemi market hall is a market building at the Hakaniemi market square in the district of Kallio in Helsinki, Finland. It was built at the start of the street Hämeentie in 1914.

pois.name: Mall of Tripla
pois.intro: The Mall of Tripla is a shopping mall in Keski-Pasila, Helsinki, Finland. The mall, along with a rebuilt railway station, opened on 17 October 2019.

pois.name: Citycenter
pois.intro: City-Center is a partly implemented plan to raze and rebuild the block between the central Helsinki streets of Kaivokatu, Keskuskatu and Aleksanterinkatu, creating a unified, modern appearance for the area. The plan was originally drafted between 1958 and 1960 by Viljo Revell; Heikki Castrén continued work on the plan after Revell's death in 1964.

pois.name: Kauppakeskus Ruoholahti
pois.intro: The Ruoholahti shopping centre is a shopping centre in the district of Ruoholahti, Helsinki, Finland. It is located in the premises of a former Alko bottling facility, where it was opened in 2003.

pois.name: AIDA Impact Showroom
pois.description:
AIDA impact is a Helsinki based jewellery studio. All the materials are natural and all the products are handmade by the AIDA team.

Socially and environmentally sustainable jewelry maker and employer. See more on website.

pois.name: Talvipuutarha
pois.intro: Le Jardin d'hiver d'Helsinki est une serre ouverte au public située à proximité du parc Eläintarha au nord de Töölönlahti à Helsinki. Le jardin d'hiver abrite une grande variété de plantes dont une grande partie de plantes tropicales.

pois.name: Tähtitorninvuori
pois.intro: Tähtitorninvuori or Tähtitorninmäki is a rocky hill about 30 meters high in Ullanlinna, Helsinki, next to the South Harbor. The hill is mostly a park, but there are also a few public buildings.

pois.name: Kaisaniemen kasvitieteellinen puutarha
pois.intro: Kajsaniemi botaniska trädgård är en botanisk trädgård som ligger i Kajsaniemiparken i Helsingfors. Kajsaniemi botaniska trädgård och Gumtäkt botaniska trädgård hör till enheten Helsingfors Universitets Botaniska Trädgård som är en institution som fungerar under Helsingfors universitet och Naturhistoriska museet.

pois.name: Vanha kirkkopuisto
pois.intro: The Old Church of Helsinki, designed by Carl Ludvig Engel and completed in 1826, is an Evangelical Lutheran church in Helsinki. The oldest existing church in central Helsinki, the church was originally planned as a temporary building as the Ulrika Eleonora Church constructed in 1727 had become too small for the congregation and the new church, Helsinki Cathedral, would not be completed until 1852.

pois.name: Kaisaniemenpuisto
pois.intro: Kaisaniemi park is a popular park, in the center of Helsinki, in the region of Kluuvi. The Kaisaniemi Park was named after Catharina "Cajsa" Wahllund.

pois.name: Kolmikulma
pois.intro: Kolmikulma, also known as the Diana Park, is a small, rectangular triangular-shaped park located in the Kaartinkaupunki district in the city center of Helsinki, Finland. It is limited by the Yrjönkatu, Uudenmaankatu and Erottajankatu streets.

pois.name: Sibeliuksenpuisto
pois.intro: Sibelius Park is a public park in the Töölö district of Helsinki, the capital of Finland. Its creation was led by the city in the 1930s, and it was officially named in honor of the country's most famous composer, Jean Sibelius, on occasion of his 80th birthday, on 6 December 1945.

pois.name: Länsi-Mustasaari
pois.intro: Länsi Mustasaari est une île à Helsinki en Finlande. Länsi Mustasaari fait partie du quartier de Suomenlinna.

pois.name: Pikku Mustasaari
pois.intro: Pikku Mustasaari ou Pikku-musta est une île du quartier de Suomenlinna à Helsinki en Finlande. Les bâtiments fortifiés de Pikku Mustasaari font partie du dispositif de fortification de Suomenlinna.

pois.name: Yliopiston apteekki
pois.intro: Universitetets Apotek är en finländsk apotekskedja som ägs av Helsingfors universitet, och är Finlands största apoteksrörelse. År 2017 hade koncernen en omsättning på 292 miljoner euro.

pois.name: Sotamuseon Maneesi
pois.intro: The Military Museum of Finland is the central museum of the Finnish Defence Forces and the national special museum of military history. It is located in Helsinki and it is part of the Finnish National Defence University.

pois.name: Hotelli- ja ravintolamuseo
pois.intro: The Hotel and Restaurant Museum specializes in the history of Finnish hotels, restaurants, cafés, tourism and culinary culture. The museum has been located in Kaapelitehdas, Helsinki, Finland since 1993.

pois.name: Tiedemuseo Liekki
pois.intro: Helsinki University Museum Flame is the museum of the University of Helsinki. Helsinki University Museum Flame was established in 2003 by merging several museums operating under the auspices of the University of Helsinki.

pois.name: Hakasalmen huvila
pois.intro: Villa Hakasalmi, also known as Villa Karamzin, is an architecturally and historically important 19th-century villa located in the Etu-Töölö district of central Helsinki, Finland. The villa is situated in a prominent position on Mannerheimintie, next to Finlandia Hall and opposite the National Museum.

pois.name: Lauttis
pois.intro: Lauttis is a shopping centre in Lauttasaari, Helsinki, Finland. It was opened on 1 December 2016.

pois.name: Emma - Espoon modernin taiteen museo
pois.nameEnglish: EMMA - Espoo Museum of Modern Art
pois.intro: The EMMA – Espoo Museum of Modern Art, is a major art museum in Espoo in southern Finland. After the founding of Espoo Art Museum Foundation in September 2002, EMMA opened its doors for visitors in 2006.

pois.name: Kampin keskus
pois.intro: Kauppakeskus Kamppi Helsinki on Kampissa, Helsingin ydinkeskustassa sijaitseva kauppakeskus. Yhdessä Helsingin linja-autoaseman kanssa se muodostaa Kampin keskuksen, johon liittyy myös Kampin metroasema.

pois.name: Kiasma
pois.intro: Nykytaiteen museon rakennuksen Kiasman on suunnitellut yhdysvaltalainen arkkitehti Steven Holl, joka voitti museon suunnittelusta käydyn arkkitehtikilpailun vuonna 1993. Rakennus sijaitsee Helsingin ydinkeskustassa naapureinaan muun muassa monumentaaliset Postitalo, Sanomatalo, Eduskuntatalo ja Musiikkitalo.

terminalResolution.notes: Hernesaari, Katajanokka, and West Harbour are all Helsinki cruise quays. Added the Olympia Terminal in the South Harbour, which also takes cruise ships (from Google Maps).
